response.sql:
WITH patient_averages AS (
    SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
), overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) AS overall_avg
    FROM patient_averages
), kept AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.avg_hgb, o.overall_avg
    FROM patient_averages AS p
    CROSS JOIN overall AS o
    WHERE p.avg_hgb > o.overall_avg
), kept_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) AS mean_kept_avg
    FROM kept
)
SELECT k.ID,
       k.avg_hgb,
       k.avg_hgb - k.overall_avg AS above_overall_average,
       k.avg_hgb - m.mean_kept_avg AS difference_from_kept_mean
FROM kept AS k
CROSS JOIN kept_mean AS m
ORDER BY difference_from_kept_mean DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Patients with no non-NULL HGB records have no defined average and are excluded from both the overall average and the results; AVG ignores NULL HGB values.
